data.standardized_narrative: Unable to determine gross claims opening reserves or a quantified gross prior-year development from the provided scanned images. The report images include an income statement showing gross premiums and claims development tables, but the scanned pages are rotated and low resolution which prevented reliable extraction of the gross claims outstanding balance and the movement in prior year reserves. No unambiguous gross prior-year movement note (insurance liabilities column) could be read with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as rotated/low-resolution scanned images. The income statement line 'Gross premiums written' (2015: GBP 244,792,251) was legible (page 8). However the Balance Sheet line for 'Claims outstanding' (gross claims reserves) and the detailed 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note could not be reliably read from the scans. Also several claims development triangle pages are present but not legible enough to extract numeric columns without risk of transcription error. Therefore opening reserves and prior year development are left null. If higher-quality (upright, higher-resolution) PDFs are provided, a full extraction including triangle and movement note can be completed.
